title: Lines through a FILE *
summary: fdopen turns a pipe end into a stream: use fprintf and fgets.
hints: `FILE *out = fdopen(p[1], "w");` then `fprintf(out, "alpha\n");` and `fclose(out)` (which flushes and closes the descriptor).
The parent reads with `FILE *in = fdopen(p[0], "r"); while (fgets(line, sizeof line, in)) ...`.
